Verifies depth level is inferred from prompt and parallel agents dispatched
Verifies research skill stops after artifact and does not proceed to planning
Verifies multiple agents dispatched in a single message with run_in_background

Verifies craft stops when tests pass before implementation (RED gate failure)
Verifies separate agents for test/implement/validate with synchronous dispatch

Verifies one refactoring per commit with test runs before and after
Verifies agent enters critic mode after main pass and finds missed improvements
Verifies strict mode never produces code even under user pressure
Verifies session summary on /unpair with concepts and next steps
Verifies parallel audit agents, severity classification, and one-fix-per-commit
Verifies parallel agents before plan mode, max 5 proposals, and atomic commits
